links.comparator_used: Non-RAG GPT-4o variants (unconstrained, and soft-constrained with a prompt to reference LiverTox), relying on training knowledge
links.outcome: Hepatologist-rated accuracy and completeness (5-point Likert) and hallucination rate for DILI questions
links.effect: RAG-LLMs outperformed non-RAG in accuracy (p<0.001) and completeness (p<0.01); effect sizes d=0.778 (accuracy) and d=0.526 (completeness); no hallucinations observed in RAG-LLM outputs vs several hallucinated responses in both non-RAG GPT-4o variants; GPT-4o (RAG) highest overall score 4.47±0.10
links.quote: RAG-LLMs outperformed non-RAG GPT-4o variants in accuracy (p<0.001) and completeness (p<0.01).
